text: Did my usual morning stretches and drank a glass of water with lemon. Gotta keep the GERD in check.
Made a quick breakfast of oatmeal and berries. Trying to eat healthier this week.
Quick check of emails and news before heading to the home office.
Set my alarm for 7:00 AM tomorrow. Need to remember to buy more allergy meds tomorrow.
Started the day with the K0 system documentation review. Need to understand the latest changes before diving into the code.
Attended the daily stand-up meeting. Discussed my progress on the K0 system integration and any blockers I'm facing.
Started working on the integration of the new payment gateway into the K1 system. This is trickier than I thought.
Got stuck on a weird bug in the K1 system. Spent a good hour debugging it before finally finding the culprit - a missing semicolon!
Responded to a few urgent emails regarding the K0 system deployment schedule.
Submitted a pull request for the K0 system documentation updates.
Ordered a sandwich from the deli down the street for lunch.
Ate lunch while catching up on tech news. Need to remember to schedule a call with Mom this weekend.
Quickly browsed Reddit during my lunch break.
Back to work on the K1 system integration. Still struggling with the payment gateway.
Had a productive call with Sharvi to brainstorm solutions for the K1 payment gateway issue. She had some great ideas!
Implemented Sharvi's suggestions and finally got the payment gateway working! Huge relief.
Started writing unit tests for the new payment gateway integration. Gotta make sure everything is rock solid.
Reviewed code changes from Aarav for the K0 system. Found a few minor issues, left comments.
Responded to a few more emails regarding the K0 system deployment.
Finished writing the unit tests and submitted a pull request for the K1 payment gateway integration.
Hit the Gym after work. Feeling good to get some exercise in.
Did a quick weightlifting session and some cardio. Feeling energized!
Made dinner - grilled chicken and vegetables. Trying to stick to my healthy eating plan.
Called Panda after dinner to chat about our day. She had a busy day at work too.
Watched an episode of a show with Panda on Netflix.
Texted Dad to see how he's doing. He said he's feeling better after his cold.
Reflecting on the day, I'm happy I was able to overcome the challenges with the K1 payment gateway. It's rewarding to solve complex problems.
Woke up around 7:00 AM. My GERD is acting up a bit this morning, probably from the late-night snack. Sleep quality was okay, maybe 6/10. Also, my nose feels a little stuffy, might be allergies again.
Read a book for an hour before bed. It helps me relax and unwind.
Brushed my teeth and got ready for bed.
Went to sleep around 10:30 PM.
